pattern.description: Live-action narrative footage: a hand pushes a door handle in close-up, hard cut to a wide office shot as the character enters and sits, with a slow handheld-style push-in.
pattern.why_premium: Cinematic film-grade footage (shallow depth, letterbox, motivated cut on the door action) grounds the AI product story in a relatable human scenario before any UI appears.

build_hint.gsap: Footage, not a motion graphic: hard cut between clips, then gsap.fromTo(clip, {scale: 1.0}, {scale: 1.03, x: -6, duration: 2, ease: 'none'}) to fake a slow dolly push-in on the wide shot.
build_hint.remotion: <Sequence> per clip with a hard cut; on the wide clip interpolate(frame, [0, 60], [1, 1.03]) for transform: scale with linear easing (no spring).

notes: The burst spans a hard cut (energy spike around frame ~1886) from the door close-up to the office, so it is two clips inside one detected shot (s038); the shot detector may have missed this cut. b02 is a thin sliver at the letterbox edge and was not treated as an element. Camera verdict push_in is small (scale 1.032).
